system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:41:49 UTC, a domain account named it_helper was created by the subject account omar.haddad.
At 13:41:56 UTC, it_helper was added to the group named Administrators. The event records the same subject account and logon ID as the account-creation event; the target group SID ends in RID 512.

The creation and privileged-group addition are inconsistent with the supplied account-management practices: help-desk temporary accounts use the tmp.<name> pattern and receive no administrator rights, and omar.haddad is identified as the only IT administrator. This supports treating the activity as malicious absent authorization evidence.

known_telemetry_limitations: The provided account-management events identify the subject account and logon ID but do not identify the originating host or the human operating the session. (T007-00092, T007-00093)
The provided records do not include an approval or change record for creating it_helper or adding it to Administrators.
The supplied records do not show whether it_helper was subsequently used.
claims_not_established: Whether the account creation and group addition had authorization not included in the supplied evidence.
Whether omar.haddad personally performed the actions or the account/session was compromised.
Which host originated the account-management actions.
Whether it_helper authenticated or performed any further activity.
additional_evidence_needed: Correlate logon ID 0xc5db44d with domain-controller logon and authentication records, including source host and address.
Review change approvals and administrator communications for the account creation and group membership change.
Collect endpoint process and logon telemetry from the identified originating host and WS-OHADDAD-01.
Review subsequent authentication, group-membership, and resource-access activity for it_helper.
